The unified atomic mass unit, u, is a non-SI unit usually used by scientists to state atomic masses.

What is u?

  1. It is the mean of the masses of a proton and a neutron.
  2. It is the mean of the masses of protons and neutrons in all chemical elements.
  3. It is  the mass of an 168O atom.
  4. It is  the mass of a 126C atom.
